notes: One marker per ending. The planner runs as a session, so nothing holds an exit status for it and published, refused and budget-spent all present as the same silence; the marker is written last on either ending, reusing the chain's own stem, so a watcher finds it the way it finds the published chain. Cited against A6, which is the one register shape it does carry - its at is a measured A6 timestamp and the lint reaches it. No schema judges the rest of it: it is not a contract shape, and a lint holds its shape instead. The refused document carries no files list and the published one carries no reason, which is the difference the outcome word already states.
